meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会按项目意图生成面向 Google Stitch 的 DESIGN.md 设计规范，写明配色、字体、不对称布局、动效与禁用模式，并作为 Stitch 生成界面的依据。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 Google Stitch 做界面设计、或需要一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范时触发；通常在描述完项目气质后执行。

say.text: 给我的项目生成一份 Stitch 的 DESIGN.md，气质偏画廊留白。
say.note: 会输出含配色、字体、布局与动效条款的规范文件。

say.text: 把当前页面的按钮改成带按压反馈、无外发光的样子。
say.note: 会在规范中加入对应组件行为，并覆盖到 Stitch 界面。

say.text: 按这份 DESIGN.md 给 Stitch 写一版新的屏幕视觉描述。
say.note: 输出可直接用于 Stitch 提示的视觉描述段落。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates a DESIGN.md design specification for Google Stitch, documenting colors, typography, asymmetric layouts, motion and banned patterns. It serves as the source of truth for Stitch screen generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a Google Stitch UI design or a DESIGN.md design specification, typically after describing the project's visual vibe.

say_en.text: Create a DESIGN.md for my project with a gallery-like, airy aesthetic.
say_en.note: Outputs a spec covering palette, type, layout, and motion.

say_en.text: Update the buttons in the spec to have tactile press feedback and no outer glow.
say_en.note: Writes component behavior rules into the DESIGN.md.

say_en.text: Use this DESIGN.md to produce a new screen visual description for Stitch.
say_en.note: Gives a ready-to-use visual description for Stitch prompting.
